build_rag_kg_model: build a RAG knowledge graph baseline model using Llama 3 8B with vLLM and sentence transformers
run_batch_generate_answer: run batch answer generation for queries using search results and knowledge graph data
extract_chunks_from_html: extract sentence chunks from HTML search results using BeautifulSoup and blingfire with Ray parallelization
calculate_sentence_embeddings: calculate normalized sentence embeddings using a MiniLM sentence transformer model for retrieval
extract_entities_from_queries: extract structured entities from queries including domain, movie names, and financial metrics
